test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Success in any field depends ______ hard work and determination.
solution:
The correct answer is **"on"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given options, **"on"** is most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• We always say depend/depending 'ON', never “of” or “in”.<
